guard/31292.htm.text: Captain Andrei: Do you have any idea how hard it is to keep the peace in a village like this? Not a day goes by without some low-lifes showing up and making trouble! Monsters lurk outside the village. The rich people keep complaining about the lack of security.. It's a thankless job I have...

links.text: "Who is the lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"
